title: pm-dispatch(rest-channel): record the first measured automerge_disable / pr_draft stroke in place of 「反向两 op 未实调」, now that the disarm rule mandates both ops
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS

Filing gate ②: a governed rules line made stale by in-flight work. Found by the contract review of PR #27845 (#27809, the disarm rule), record 6513017524, should-fix 3. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (#19287). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

Business reason: PR #27845 makes `automerge_disable` (and `pr_draft` where disable alone does not dequeue) a mandatory seat act on a FAIL or a moved head. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md:57` still says the two reverse ops were never called (「反向两 op 未实调」), so a seat reading it cannot tell whether the ops it is now required to send are known to work.
Reader who acts: the `domain:skills` lane, after the first real invocation of either op through the relay.

## Wanted

- After the first relay stroke that sends `automerge_disable` or `pr_draft`, `rest-channel.md:57` records the measured reading (the run, the stored state read back, and whether the PR left the queue) in place of 「反向两 op 未实调」. If a dequeue is observed, also update `references/platform-readings.md:41-43`.
- Rule text only, no gate. Governed `.claude/**`.

## Blocked-by

PR #27845 (the rule that mandates the ops). This also waits on the first real invocation, which a seat records here when it happens.

Blocked-by: #27845

## Dedupe

Issues searched for `反向两 op 未实调` and `automerge_disable rest-channel`: no card.
